description: Fetch a single Rhea reaction by its Rhea id (e.g. "RHEA:14293" or "14293"). Returns the balanced plain-text equation plus EC number, ChEBI compound, UniProt enzyme and PubMed cross-references. Rhea is the expert-curated biochemical reaction reference used by UniProt and KEGG. Keyless.

id.description: A Rhea reaction id, e.g. "RHEA:14293" or "14293".

name: get_reaction
